package.title: Tempo.Blazor.Modeling
package.description: Modeling editor components for Tempo.Blazor, including BPMN, UML, ArchiMate, ERD notation profiles and diagram generation.

gettingStarted.title: Tempo.Blazor.Modeling
gettingStarted.overview: Modeling editor components for Tempo.Blazor, including BPMN, UML, ArchiMate, ERD notation profiles and diagram generation.

items.description: Demo modeling provider with deterministic BPMN and ArchiMate sample data.

members.name: ProviderKeyValue
members.description: Provider key used for the built-in demo modeling data.

members.name: Element
members.description: Existing semantic model element reused by the new diagram node.

members.name: NodeId

members.name: Point

items.description: Extension methods for registering Tempo.Blazor modeling editor services.

members.name: AddTempoBlazorModeling
members.description: Registers the services required by the modeling component group. Also calls AddTempoBlazorDiagramEditor(), because modeling builds on the diagram editor.

items.description: Shows a generated modeling diagram through the diagram editor canvas.

parameters.name: ActiveDraggedElement
parameters.description: Modeling element currently being dragged from the model tree.

parameters.name: AllowNodeDrop
parameters.description: When false, model tree drops are ignored without mutating the preview document.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the preview root.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: Generated diagram document to show in the preview. Null renders the pre-generation empty state.

parameters.name: DocumentChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the embedded diagram editor reports a document mutation.

parameters.name: OnDrop
parameters.description: Raised when a dragged modeling tree item is dropped onto the preview canvas.

parameters.name: OnGenerateRequested
parameters.description: Raised when the user requests a fresh diagram generation from the currently loaded model.

parameters.name: OnNodeDropped
parameters.description: Raised after a tree element is reused as a new diagram node.

parameters.name: OnOpenInEditor
parameters.description: Raised when the user requests opening the generated document in the full diagram editor.

parameters.name: OnRelationshipSelected
parameters.description: Raised when a relationship edge is selected in the generated preview.

items.description: Loads a semantic modeling source and presents an initial modeling editor shell.

parameters.name: AllowNodeDrop
parameters.description: Whether model tree elements can be reused by dropping them onto the preview canvas.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the editor root.

parameters.name: ModelLoaderOverride
parameters.description: Optional loader used by host pages or tests to supply a model without registering a provider.

parameters.name: NotationKey
parameters.description: Optional notation key passed to the selected provider and generator.

parameters.name: OnDiagramGenerated
parameters.description: Callback raised after a model is loaded and converted into a diagram document.

parameters.name: OnNodeDropped
parameters.description: Callback raised after a model tree element is reused as a new preview node.

parameters.name: OnNotationChanged
parameters.description: Callback raised when the editor notation selection changes.

parameters.name: OnOpenInEditor
parameters.description: Callback raised when the user opens the generated diagram in the full diagram editor.

parameters.name: OnViewpointChanged
parameters.description: Callback raised when the editor viewpoint selection changes.

parameters.name: ProviderKey
parameters.description: Provider key used to select the semantic model provider. Null or empty values render the empty state.

parameters.name: ViewpointKey
parameters.description: Optional viewpoint key passed to the selected provider and used to choose the initial model view.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-editor__state
cssClasses.description: Wrapper around the state TmBadge next to the editor title (variant by state).

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-editor__status-item
cssClasses.description: One separated status item; the first carries the state icon.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-editor__status-icon
cssClasses.description: Leading status icon (check/alert/clock by state), aria-hidden.

items.description: Displays details for a selected modeling element or relationship.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the inspector root.

parameters.name: Element
parameters.description: Selected modeling element. Takes precedence when both element and relationship are supplied.

parameters.name: Elements
parameters.description: Elements used to resolve relationship source and target display names.

parameters.name: Relationship
parameters.description: Selected modeling relationship.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-inspector__type-icon
cssClasses.description: Header icon tile resolved from the semantic type (Link2 for relationships).

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-inspector__heading
cssClasses.description: Header text column: kind chip, name, type.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-inspector__name
cssClasses.description: The h3 name of the inspected element/relationship.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-inspector__type
cssClasses.description: The semantic/relationship type line.

items.description: Displays validation and generation issues for a modeling document.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the panel root.

parameters.name: Issues
parameters.description: Issues to render, in input order. Severity only colors the rows — the panel never re-sorts the list (severity filtering/sorting is backlog). Issues without a SourceElementId/SourceRelationshipId render as non-interactive list items; navigable issues render as buttons.

parameters.name: OnIssueSelected
parameters.description: Raised when the user selects an issue that points to a model element or relationship.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-issue-panel__title
cssClasses.description: Panel title heading.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-issue-panel__count
cssClasses.description: Count-only badge in the header: visible text is the bare count, the localized formulation is the aria-label.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-issue-panel__severity
cssClasses.description: Severity label in the row meta, tinted with the severity text token (`--severity--{info|warning|error}`).

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-issue-panel__category
cssClasses.description: Category label after the severity.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-issue-panel__fix
cssClasses.description: Suggested-fix toned box (primary subtle tokens) holding the icon, the localized prefix label and the fix text.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-issue-panel__fix-icon
cssClasses.description: Suggested-fix icon wrapper (TmIcon WandSparkles), aria-hidden.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-issue-panel__fix-label
cssClasses.description: Localized "Recommendation:" prefix.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-issue-panel__fix-text
cssClasses.description: The suggested fix text.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-issue-panel__chevron
cssClasses.description: Navigation chevron rendered only inside navigable issue buttons (TmIcon ChevronRight), aria-hidden.

items.description: Displays semantic modeling elements grouped by type with live filtering and selection.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the tree root.

parameters.name: CollapsedGroups
parameters.description: Optional two-way binding of the collapsed group keys. Seeded from when the instance is given a new collection; every user toggle raises CollapsedGroupsChanged with a fresh snapshot. The parameter is NEVER assigned inside the component.

parameters.name: CollapsedGroupsChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the user collapses or expands a group (not while a filter drives the transient state).

parameters.name: Elements
parameters.description: Elements rendered by the tree. They are grouped by SemanticType.

parameters.name: OnElementDragEnded
parameters.description: Raised when the user ends a drag operation from a tree node.

parameters.name: OnElementDragStarted
parameters.description: Raised when the user starts dragging an element node. Reserved for canvas drop support.

parameters.name: OnElementSelected
parameters.description: Raised when the user selects an element node.

parameters.name: SelectedElement
parameters.description: Currently selected element.

parameters.name: SelectedElementChanged
parameters.description: Raised when <see cref="SelectedElement"/> changes.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-model-tree__group-header
cssClasses.description: MO4 disclosure header: a real button with aria-expanded/aria-controls; Enter/Space native, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight collapse/expand.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-model-tree__group-chevron
cssClasses.description: Chevron icon that rotates -90deg when the group is collapsed (aria-expanded=false).

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-model-tree__group-icon
cssClasses.description: Semantic-type icon of the group.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-model-tree__group-label
cssClasses.description: Group label text (the semantic type).

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-model-tree__group-count
cssClasses.description: Element count pill of the group.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-model-tree__type-icon
cssClasses.description: Per-node semantic type icon (aria-hidden), resolved through the shared semantic type mapping.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-model-tree__node-body
cssClasses.description: Name + meta stack inside the node button.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-model-tree__drag-handle
cssClasses.description: Drag affordance icon (TmIcon GripVertical) — replaced the "::" text glyph, aria-hidden.

items.description: Shows metadata and reload controls for the modeling data source.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the panel root.

parameters.name: IsLoading
parameters.description: Whether a model load is currently in progress.

parameters.name: Metadata
parameters.description: Metadata describing the currently loaded modeling source.

parameters.name: OnLoadRequested
parameters.description: Callback raised when the user requests loading the model again.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-source-panel__title
cssClasses.description: Panel title heading (the only header text node; the freshness badge sits beside it).

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-source-panel__metadata-row
cssClasses.description: One two-column term/value row of the metadata dl, separated by a hairline from the next row.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-source-panel__term
cssClasses.description: The dt: localized term label led by the row icon.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-source-panel__metadata-icon
cssClasses.description: Row icon wrapper (database / tag / calendar), aria-hidden.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-source-panel__warning
cssClasses.description: Stale-data warning box (warning tokens, role=status).

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-source-panel__warning-icon
cssClasses.description: Warning icon wrapper (TmIcon AlertTriangle), aria-hidden.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-source-panel__warning-text
cssClasses.description: Stale warning text.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-source-panel__load
cssClasses.description: Layout hook on the load TmButton (full width); colors come from the core .tm-btn-primary.
